item.title: Finder is so frustrating and has been since day one
item.description:
📝 I’ve seen Downloads folders that have never been emptied out, and so many people who never move anything out of them. I discovered that his Desktop contained more than 1,000 files. It releases that capacity in my brain for something more important.
🔗 Read more: https://kepter.app/finder

item.title: Ask HN: UK Rescue Rocket Sheds/Houses Information
item.description:
📝 I can't seem to find pictures or significant details (nothing on Wikipedia) about the coastal buildings purportedly used to contain shipwreck rescue rocket apparatus. Many of the buildings still exist and are Grade II listed. Anyone have any additional anecdotal/local/oral tradition information that isn't found in the little blurbs online on the few websites mentioning them.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49589730
